    Gradings of mesh categories by path weights #

    For the covering formula eq:walk-hom-sum (scalar-normalization.tex): "Paths lift uniquely from a chosen starting vertex. Contextual mesh relations lift uniquely as well: all terms of a mesh have the same lifted endpoints […] The relation ideal therefore decomposes by lifted endpoints, just as the path spaces do."

    A path weight assigns to each path an element of a monoid, multiplicatively. When all terms of each mesh relation have the same weight, the mesh ideal is homogeneous and the Hom spaces of C(Q, c) are the internal direct sums of their weight parts (iSupIndep_wPart, iSup_wPart), compatibly with composition (comp_mem_wPart). For the walk-class weight of the cover (DeckGrading.lean) the weight part of degree g is the space C̃(X̃, gỸ).

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PathWeight (V : Type v) [Quiver V] (G : Type u') [Monoid G] :
    Type (max (max u' v) w)

    A multiplicative weight on the paths of a quiver.

    • deg {x y : V} : Quiver.Path x y → G
    • deg_nil (x : V) : self.deg Quiver.Path.nil = 1
    • deg_comp {x y z : V} (p : Quiver.Path x y) (q : Quiver.Path y z) : self.deg (p.comp q) = self.deg p * self.deg q
